items.title: 68090_Ed Garland oral history interview
items.q: The name 'Judi' appears only in a production note '>> [(note)] Judi' and is not mentioned in any spoken turn by the interviewee or interviewer.

ctx.x: Oh, I'll say, listen. -- So, Tootie, so then, we've got all the stuff on the tape, Ed Garland as a studio player, as a band leader and playing a wide variety of music. And that's important so people don't get the idea that you just did one thing in your career, and then that's certainly not true, now, looking in the jazz books about people talking about Jelly Roll Morton, it seems as though everyone didn't have a high opinion -- of him, least not as high as he had when he made those tapes years ago for the…
